newsitem.title: USA: OXIS gets FDA OK for INNOFLUOR assay.
newsitem.headline: OXIS gets FDA OK for INNOFLUOR assay.

text.p: OXIS International Inc said Thursday it had received clearance from the Food and Drug Administration to market its INNOFLUOR Topiramate Assay in the United States.
OXIS said the assay is the only in vitro diagnostic commercially available for measuring Topamax, a new anti-epileptic drug.
Measurement of levels of anti-epileptic drugs is common practice in the management of seizure disorders, it said.
Topamax, developed by Johnson & Johnson's R.W. Johnson Pharmaceutical Research Institute and marketed in the U.S. by J&J's Ortho-McNeil unit, was approved for U.S. sale by the FDA in December.
OXIS said it already markets the INNOFLUOR Topiramate Assay in Britain and Sweden and is positioned to market the assay in other European countries as the drug receives approval.
